label: Reference ladder
note: Package BAL24 (owner BAL21-3, 2026-11-07 08:54: "optimised player decks from cards they could have won on the way here ... random cards from packs, rewards"): Maps 0-20 and their side maps: 10 simulated players per map (seeds bal24-1 .. bal24-10), each walking the road with the game's own rewards and pack odds (tools/opt/ref5_prog.js walk: starter, tutorial, first clears, faction track and achievements, level track, Trail, end-of-map / free / bought packs), each player's best deck from that collection by tools/opt/deckopt.js --mode prog, with the strongest leader the player holds, at the Map reference's level. Ranked weak (1) to strong by the road win rate (ladder seeds 5300 + 37g). Source: tools/bal24/ladder_sim_2026_11_07.js. Maps 21-24 (m21-m24) keep BAL13 / BAL17's sampled ladder. Package BAL13 (owner 2026-11-02 19:56: "Make at least 10 reference decks"): per map (every PRO entry: Maps 0-20 and their side maps), 10 decks a player could hold there (the map-true pool: the map's own cards plus what a player holds by then, within the map's rarity cap, no faction or enemy-only card; 20 cards, at most 12 different, the rarity copy caps), rank 1 the weakest to rank 10 the strongest by their win rate against the map's road fights. Played at the Map reference's level (referencePlayerLevel), each with the leader a player holds at that map (owner 21:37; tools/bal13/lib_leader_2026_11_02.js leaderFor, the Wandering Traveller when none), summoned by your seat's AI. A per-map ladder ("ladder" by map id, not "decks" by map number). tools/opt/ref_decks.js bakes it into arena_app.js REF_DECK_SETS (owner 22:15: the game's "Reference (Random)" deals one of the map's 10 at random, each with its name, leader and levelled parts); the tools play it (tools/bal13/summary_2026_11_02.js). BAL17 (2026-11-05): Maps 21-24 (m21-m24) added, built by the same tool and rule; the other maps' entries kept as they were. BAL18 (2026-11-05): the decks that left their map-true pool after CONTENT10 rebuilt by tools/bal18/ladder_stale_2026_11_05.js with BAL13's candidates, measure and choice; every other deck kept as it was.

rule.source: simulated players (BAL24) for Maps 0-20; BAL13 sampling for Maps 21-24

bal13.pool: tools/opt/deckopt.js poolsFor mode map-true, minus enemy-only cards
bal13.choice: 10 targets evenly between the weakest and the strongest candidate's road win rate (ladder seeds 5300 + 37g); nearest candidate at least 4 copies apart
